summary: Comprehensive customer-flow QA for Zitex. Backend: 24/24 pytest cases pass (1 skipped due to warranty data gap). Frontend: login→home routing works, banners/tabs/social/competitions/profile/cart all render. Found 2 CRITICAL bugs that block customer experience: (1) Used Devices filter returns 0 results because backend strict matches condition='used' but seed data uses 'used_3months'; (2) product detail page mislabels used_3months products as 'جديد (New)' due to strict equality check.

critical.issue: Returns 0 results although DB has used_3months products. Either filter should accept any condition starting with 'used' or seed data should be normalized. This breaks the Used Devices banner flow entirely.

minor.issue: Endpoint specified in QA spec returns 404. Frontend works via /api/auth/me + /api/wallet, but spec compliance is missing. Either add alias route or update spec.
Response is missing warranty_days/warranty_type fields on all seeded products, so product detail page always falls back to 'بدون ضمان'. Add fields to seed data.

ui_bugs.issue: الحالة label uses strict product.condition === 'used' check; products with condition 'used_3months' (and presumably 'used_6months') are incorrectly labeled 'جديد (New)'. Use product.condition !== 'new' or startsWith('used').
Top featured banner area renders as empty grey rectangle on first paint — banner images either fail to load or are not seeded properly. Pagination dots show 2 pages.
Main CTA reads 'Sign in' (English) on otherwise Arabic UI ('أهلاً بك في Zitex', Forget password!, Sign Up). Inconsistent localization.

integration_issues.issue: Banner navigation works but search page shows 'No results found' even though used products exist in DB. Caused by backend strict filter (see backend critical).

issues: Top hero/featured banner placeholder shows as plain grey block until images load — affects first impression
Mixed Arabic/English: title + subtitle in Arabic but button + 'Forget password!' label remain English

react_native_issues.issue: Multiple 'shadow*' style props deprecation warnings in console — should migrate to boxShadow per RN web warnings.
Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode (console warning).

action_items: FIX (CRITICAL): /app/frontend/app/product/[id].tsx line 160-161 — change `product.condition === 'used'` to `product.condition !== 'new'` (or `String(product.condition).startsWith('used')`) so used_3months/used_6months render correctly.

FIX (CRITICAL): Backend product list filter — make `?condition=used` match any value starting with 'used' (used_3months, used_6months, used_1year). Currently only exact 'used' is matched, so Used Devices banner produces empty results.
FIX (MINOR): Seed warranty_days/warranty_type on products (currently all show 'بدون ضمان').
FIX (MINOR): Localize the login Sign-in button + Forget password! label to Arabic, or set i18n for both languages.
FIX (MINOR): Investigate empty featured banner swiper on home — verify /api/banners seeds and image URLs are valid.
OPTIONAL: Implement /api/users/me/profile alias to /api/auth/me + wallet to satisfy spec.
OPTIONAL: Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow and Image resizeMode to props (RN web deprecations).
critical_code_review_comments: Strict equality for enum-like fields (condition) is brittle when DB stores granular values. Centralize a helper isUsed(condition) and use across UI (home, product detail, search).
product detail file uses payment badges as static markup; OK for MVP but should come from /api/payment-methods to avoid drift.
server.py is 2225 lines — should be split into routers (auth, products, social, orders, competitions) for maintainability.

success_rate.frontend: ~80% (login/home/tabs/social/contests/profile/product detail/cart work; Used Devices filter + condition label broken)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_customer_flow_post and TEST_poll_q posts via merchant-token in social tests; not cleaned up (will appear in social feed until manually removed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two critical bugs need fixing before retest: (1) product detail strict condition check, (2) backend used filter. After fix, re-run pytest /app/backend/tests/test_customer_flow.py and re-verify the Used Devices banner → search page shows products and product detail of iPhone 14 (Used) shows 'مستعمل (Used)'. Also remove the TEST_ social posts I left.
rca_of_issue: Bug 1 (Used Devices empty): Backend product list endpoint compares condition exactly. Seed inserts variants ('used_3months') instead of generic 'used'. Frontend Used Devices banner correctly navigates with ?condition=used. Fix: relax server-side filter to match any condition LIKE 'used%' OR normalize seed values. Bug 2 (Used product shown as New): /app/frontend/app/product/[id].tsx line 160-161 uses strict === 'used'. Same condition='used_3months' value bypasses the check and falls through to 'جديد (New)'. Fix: change to `product.condition !== 'new'` (same convention already used on line 72 for the corner badge).
